recipe.text: Distinct concept: a medieval falchion — broad single-edged curved cleaver blade widening to a clip point, cross guard + round pommel, unlike the prior spear/dagger. Cube-generated + save_mesh'd for an above-primitive silhouette (verified by one front/right capture). Toolified with Handle at the hilt, placed in StarterPack. Fast-swing behavior (0.10/0.12/0.30) with a short-reach moderate-damage hitbox (30 dmg, 6 studs, 0.30s server cooldown).
